visual.general_description: Four-panel set of operative close-up photographs (a-d) of a tube shunt revision, with arrows in panels a, c and d.
visual.detailed_description: Four square color operative close-ups in a two-by-two grid, each with a white circle bearing a lowercase letter a to d at its lower left. Panel a shows a small gray area with a thread arc and a black arrow; panel b a pink rounded disc with radiating dark threads; panel c forceps lifting a thin pink flap with a red arrow; panel d a pink-red area outlined by eight red arrows with three instruments entering the field. No text other than the panel letters is visible.

panels.general_description: Operative close-up of an exposed tube area with a black arrow.
panels.detailed_description: Close-up color operative photograph. A small rounded gray translucent area with a pale elongated strip along its upper edge sits within pale yellow-white tissue ringed by red; a curved dark blue-violet thread arcs below and left of the gray area. Red blood vessels branch across the whitish surface in the upper right and bottom. A dark gray instrument-like region fills the upper left. A black arrow starting at lower left points up and right toward the curved thread near the gray area. A white circle with the printed letter a is at the lower left.

Pale glossy whitish tissue with a red streak lies below and around it; red vessels cross the upper right; bright specular reflections speckle the surface. A white circle with the printed letter b is at the lower left.

visual.general_description: Single slit-lamp style color photograph of an eye with a sutured gray-white patch near the iris edge.
visual.detailed_description: Color slit-lamp style close-up photograph of an eye with eyelids at the edges. A round black pupil with two small white reflections lies at the right within a brown-gray iris. The pale white tissue at the left and top contains a few thin red vessels and, near the left of the iris edge, a gray-white patch with about eight fine dark suture ends radiating from it. A smooth grayish translucent zone lies between the patch and the iris edge, with a few thread ends crossing it. Pink eyelid margin and dark eyelashes appear at the upper right and bottom. No printed text, panel letters, arrows or scale bar are visible.
